messages:
sam.devex: Quick note: sampleapp onboarding hit parity bug between SDK and REST. SDK sends query param `confirm=false` and header `X-Session-Trace: false` (string), server takes legacy branch and intermittently returns 401 during token refresh. curl/REST omit the param/header and succeed.

maya.sdk: That makes sensewe stringify booleans in serializer. We'll change it to omit falsy booleans for headers/query.

leo.eng: Also SDK retries 401s for mutating requests which caused duplicate creates when refresh occurred.

sam.devex: Proposed: (1) SDK: omit falsy boolean params/headers; (2) SDK: don't auto-retry 401 on POST/PUT unless idempotency-key present; (3) platform: short compatibility shim for onboarding route while SDK update rolls out.

maya.sdk: I'll open a PR with serializer change, unit tests, and a conservative retry default. ETA: EOD. Will link PR.

ci-bot: ci-check: lint ok, unit tests pending for new serializer tests.

sam.devex: Thanks. Adding a sampleapp integration test to simulate in-flight refresh and assert single create.

maya.sdk: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/523 (draft).
